headline: Anderson . Paak and Cordae’s collab album ‘HEAVY IS THE CROWN’ will debut at 1 on Billboar
body: Anderson . Paak and Cordae’s collab album ‘HEAVY IS THE CROWN’ will debut at 1 on Billboard’s Rap Albums chart, outselling Yeat and Drake The project moved over 30K units in its first week and is also expected to land at 10 on the Billboard 200, according to HITS Thoughts?
